subject: Emotions
title: The Other Intelligence
description: A fast breakdown of The Other Intelligence for builders.

hook.text: A brilliant engineer with a 145 IQ keeps getting fired. Not for bad work—for alienating every team he joins.

buildup.text: Daniel Goleman's 1995 book argued that emotional intelligence matters more than IQ for life success.

discovery.text: EQ is the ability to recognize, understand, manage, and use emotions—in yourself and others—effectively.

twist.text: IQ predicts academic performance. But EQ predicts leadership, relationships, and mental health more strongly.

climax.text: Goleman identified five components: self-awareness, self-regulation, motivation, empathy, and social skills.

punchline.text: Being smart gets you hired. Being emotionally smart keeps you there.

quiz.question: Who popularized the concept of emotional intelligence?
